name: Black Bear Diner Volcano Bacon & Avocado Skillet (Danger Zone)
brandOrRestaurant: Black Bear Diner (American Fork / Sandy, UT)
whyItWorks: A massive mountain of country fried red potatoes, thick smoked bacon, sausage, melted cheddar-jack, diced avocados, and sour cream. Over 60g of heavy grease and dairy sparks severe gut motility and diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: High Fat & Grease Warning: Avoid breakfast skillets. Order 2 eggs scrambled soft with plain white toast instead.
